<item>
      <title>The Day the Birds Fell from the Sky</title>
      <description>Krishna Deva Raya breaks a forty-year peace with the Adil Shah of Bijapur after a trusted Moor named Cide Mercar absconds to the Sultan's court with forty thousand gold pardaos. He marches a million-strong army on the fortress city of Raichur, fights a battle so loud that birds fall from the sky, sees his front line shattered by Bijapur's massed artillery, sends a ring to his queens as token of his death — and then turns the rout into a total massacre by ordering his cavalry to kill his own fleeing men. Based on A Forgotten Empire (Vijayanagara) by Robert Sewell (1900), drawing on the chronicle of Fernão Nuniz.</description>
